messages:
Sofia (partnerships): Hey team :wave: — want to align on a gentle deprecation plan for the legacy /sync_batch endpoint. proposal: phased opt-in for batch_v2, 60d deprecation window, marketplace listing update, and a joint partner comms cadence.
Liam (pm): +1. can you surface the main breaking behavior we need partners to test?
Sofia (partnerships): primary incompat: batch_v2 enforces per-item metadata and uses chunked streaming for large payloads. old clients will still work for 60d but without guarantees on performance.
Priya (solutions): for SIs we need a migration guide and a migration checklist they can run during onboarding. also, any changes to marketplace packaging?
marketplace-bot: New draft entry created: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/drafts/batch_v2-migration (access: partnerships team)
Ethan (eng): Tech detail: batch_v2 introduces a `items` array with explicit `metadata` per item and returns `chunk_id` for streamed parts. sample request:
```
POST /v2/batch_v2
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "items": [{"id":"1","meta":{...},"input":"..."}]
}
```
Response streams delta objects with `chunk_id`.
Raj (partner-eng): For cloud partners we need to confirm marketplace compatibility (zip/publish pipeline). I can run a quick smoke in the staging pub-sub flow if we freeze the schema by EOD Friday.
Sofia (partnerships): timeline suggestion:
- Week 0: announce opt-in SDK with dual support and migration docs to partners + private beta for key SIs
- Week 2: marketplace package includes `supports_batch_v2` flag and updated badges
- Week 4: open canary for 10% traffic on hosted API, partner SIs invited to monitor
- Week 8: begin 60-day deprecation notice for /sync_batch
- Week 12: sunset (hard) unless partner opt-out agreements exist
Liam (pm): Legal/comm check: need legal sign-off on the 60d SLA change and joint announcement language. Priya: can you own the partner-facing FAQ?
Priya (solutions): Yup. I'll draft the FAQ and migration checklist. Can we get a sample partner newsletter blurb before Wed?
Ethan (eng): Engineering asks: a) telemetry flag to track old endpoint usage per partner, b) backward-compat shim in SDKs for one release, c) update SDK semver notes. ETA: shim + telemetry in two sprints.
Raj (partner-eng): For SIs: I'll map the top 12 integrations that use /sync_batch and surface any rework needed. Call out heavy users (large docs ingestion) for custom chunking tests.
Sofia (partnerships): Outreach plan: 1:1 with top 10 partners this week, group webinar next Tue, marketplace banner + doc link day of beta. Who can lead the webinar?
Liam (pm): I can host the webinar with Priya. Raj — please prepare 2-3 partner migration case studies.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing update window opens in 3 business days.
Priya (solutions): Draft timeline for partner comms: invite list by Thu, slides + migration snippet by Mon, dry-run webinar on Mon PM.
Ethan (eng): Also: need to lock the OpenAPI schema and provide a sample client patch (Python + Node). I'll add PRs to sdk-examples repo and tag `partner-migration`.
Sofia (partnerships): Action items: Sofia — partner outreach list; Priya — FAQ + webinar; Ethan — shim+telemetry + client samples; Raj — SI impact mapping; Liam — legal + announcement copy. Let's reconvene Friday 11am PT for pre-launch check. :white_check_mark:
Liam (pm): noted. I'll loop in Legal and Comms after this thread.
Raj (partner-eng): Quick question — do we want a toggle in marketplace metadata for partners to opt-out of auto-upgrade? some partners prefer manual cutovers.
Priya (solutions): Yes, include `manual_cutover: true|false` in the marketplace metadata manifest. we'll document cutover steps.
Ethan (eng): Will implement telemetry to respect `manual_cutover` — if true, old endpoint won't be redirected in our canary.
Sofia (partnerships): Great. last ask: please add short migration snippets for major SI platforms (GCP functions, AWS Lambda, on-prem containers). Priya/Raj can coordinate.
marketplace-bot: Draft announcement scheduled: 1719992000.
Sofia (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll put an official partner advisory in the shared drive and ping top 10 now.
Liam (pm): Thanks — see you Fri 11am.
